observer_read_only_behavior.analysis: The wrapper calls the captured original predict once with the original argument objects and returns the exact output object. Added work is tensor sampling, statistics, concatenation and copied CPU observations; it invokes no neural module or extra backbone/head/preview forward. The original E0 may already execute its selected auxiliary correction.
observer_read_only_behavior.allowed_mutations: Installation temporarily shadows model.predict; begin and predict change only observer bookkeeping. close restores the captured bound callable. Existing tracker state, templates, history, frame and since_query updates remain the original E0 code.
observer_read_only_behavior.frozen_parameters: freeze sets eval and requires_grad_(False); main and observer are no_grad; final checks compare all model state_dict tensors to CPU clones and assert all parameter gradients are None. There is no optimizer or backward call in this runner.
observer_read_only_behavior.parameter_count: The runner asserts 103374215 parameters. This review did not instantiate the real network or independently measure that count.
observer_read_only_behavior.record_lifetime: Feature and box arrays are copied, preventing later template/history updates or output reuse from altering the saved observation.

roi_coordinates.box_convention: Head boxes are normalized crop cx,cy,w,h, not xywh. ROI sample positions are cx,cy plus {-1/3,0,1/3} times width/height. They use output['box'], the final normalized E0 box, on the original primary modality's feature grid.
roi_coordinates.feature_grid: Row-major patch tokens reshape to [1,768,16,16]. The grid's last dimension is x then y. Normalized crop coordinates are mapped by 2*u-1 with align_corners=False, placing feature centers at (index+0.5)/16.
roi_coordinates.correction_coordinate_system: E0 correct scatters auxiliary evidence back into the same 16x16 search grid, so even a corrected final box remains in the primary search crop's coordinate system. This is not the independent-region E1 coordinate system.
roi_coordinates.coverage: Fraction of nine ROI sample centers inside [0,1)^2. Outside centers are zeroed and all nine samples remain in the mean denominator. This is not exact box-area coverage or validity of original-image pixels inside a padded search crop.

feature_layout.contents: 768-dimensional primary feature ROI at final normalized box
Primary windowed score maximum, mean and normalized entropy

cpu_axis_probe.interpretation: Correct x/y order and normalized feature-center mapping within float32 rounding.

roi_coordinates.primary_roi_naming: Primary refers to the source feature modality, not necessarily primary['box']. This is consistent with the saved final_iou target; no primary-box localization label or whole-image deep recovery representation is claimed.
